card.name: Cutting, slicing and splitting instructions
card.fires_on: Small words like "a", "the" or a closing bracket inside instructions about cutting, slicing or splitting something, just before a shape or line word such as "longitudinal", "score line" or "slice".

modes.label: Incision or slice wording
modes.description: Words leading into how a cut is made, such as an incision or slice direction.
modes.example: make<< a>> longitudinal (parallel to the implant) inc

modes.label: Splitting tablets or cutting products
modes.description: Words before "score line" or "release liner" when a tablet or patch is split or cut.
modes.example: Split the 15 mg tablet along<< the>> score line to achieve 7.5

card.writes: It seems to push toward shape and form words, such as "-shaped" or "lined", and away from unrelated names.
card.plain: It fires on little words in directions for cutting or splitting something, right before the shape or line of the cut is named.
